fictional_notice: SmileCare Dental is a fictional clinic created for a public portfolio project (WP_AI_Support_Agent). It is not a real clinic, and the dentists, address, phone number and prices are invented. Any resemblance to an actual clinic or person is coincidental.
name: SmileCare Dental
description: A family dental clinic in Pune offering check-ups, cleaning, root canal treatment, braces and teeth whitening.
address: 2nd Floor, Shanti Plaza, 14 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune, Maharashtra 411005

dentists.name: Dr. Ananya Kulkarni
dentists.focus: Root canal treatment and tooth pain

dentists.name: Dr. Farah Sheikh
dentists.focus: General check-ups, cleaning, whitening and children's dentistry

services.name: Consultation and check-up
services.description: Examination by a dentist, with a treatment plan if anything is needed.
services.price_note: X-rays, if needed, are charged separately.

services.name: Teeth cleaning (scaling and polishing)
services.description: Removal of tartar and stains, followed by polishing.
services.price_note: Depends on how much tartar has built up.

services.name: Root canal treatment (RCT)
services.description: Treatment of an infected or damaged tooth nerve, usually over one to three visits.
services.price_note: Per tooth. A crown, if advised, is charged separately.

services.name: Braces
services.description: Metal or ceramic braces to straighten teeth, with monthly adjustment visits.
services.price_note: Full treatment. Metal braces are at the lower end and ceramic at the higher end; EMI is available.

services.name: Teeth whitening
services.description: In-clinic whitening to lighten stains and discolouration.
services.price_note: Depends on the method and number of sessions.

booking_note: Patients share their name, concern and a preferred day and time on WhatsApp. The front desk confirms the final slot; the assistant never confirms an appointment itself.
payment_methods_note: Cash, UPI and debit/credit cards are accepted at the clinic. The WhatsApp assistant never collects payment or card details.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Share your name, what you need help with, and a preferred day and time here on WhatsApp. Our front desk will confirm the slot with you.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cash, UPI and debit/credit cards at the clinic. EMI options are available for braces.

faqs.question: Do you accept dental insurance?
faqs.answer: We don't offer cashless insurance, but we provide bills and treatment documents for reimbursement claims.

faqs.question: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faqs.answer: Message us here and our team will call you back as soon as possible. For heavy bleeding, swelling that affects breathing or swallowing, or a serious injury, go to the nearest hospital emergency department or call 112.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our dentists see children from the age of 3.

faqs.question: Is there parking at the clinic?
faqs.answer: Two-wheeler parking is available in the building. Car parking is on the street.

faqs.question: Are the prices final?
faqs.answer: Prices are rough ranges. The dentist confirms the exact cost after examining you.
